name: Arrow Columnar SoA Telemetry
description: Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) layout with validity bitmasks for zero-copy column batch processing without per-element heap allocation or pointer indirection.
recommendations: Adopt Structure of Arrays (SoA) layout for high-frequency telemetry streams to enable SIMD vectorization and cache locality.
Use contiguous fixed-size bitmasks to track nullability/validity instead of per-record Option<T> or Box<T> wrappers.
Ensure all column buffers derive bytemuck::Pod and bytemuck::Zeroable with repr(C) geometry.
